title: Jubilant city of Ayodhya
introduction: In this chapter, Sumantra arrives at Rama's palace to fetch him to royal court. Rama starts to the royal court to meet his father. On the way Rama observes the jubiliant city.
closing: Thus completes sixteenth sarga of Ayodhya Kanda in Srimad Ramayana.

verses.devanagari:
स तदंतःपुरद्वारं समतीत्य जनाकुलम् |
प्रविविक्तां ततः कक्ष्यामाससाद पुराणवित्
प्रास कार्मुक बिभ्रद्भिर् युवभिर् मृष्ट कुण्डलैः |
अप्रमादिभिर् एक अग्रैः स्वनुरक्तैः अधिष्ठिताम्
verses.iast:
sa tat antaḥ pura dvāram samatītya jana ākulam |
praviviktām tataḥ kakṣyām āsasāda purāṇavit
prāsa kārmuka bibhradbhir yuvabhir mṛṣṭa kuṇḍalaiḥ |
apramādibhir eka agraiḥ svanuraktaiḥ adhiṣṭhitām
verses.translation: That Sumantra, who knew the ancient sacred works, passed over the crowded entrance of the palace and reached the secluded inner apartment. In that area of the inner apartment, some youths , wearing darts and bows, were on security-duty with due vigilance and attention. They were all greatly devoted to the king and were wearing polished ear-rings.

glosses.meaning: who knew the ancient sacred works

verses.devanagari:
तत्र काषायिणो वृद्धान् वेत्रपाणीन् स्वमंकृतान् |
ददर्शविष्ठितान् द्वारि स्त्रध्यक्षान् सुसमाहितान्
verses.iast:
tatra kāṣāyiṇo vṛddhān vetra pāṇīn svalamkṛtān |
dadarśa viṣṭhitān dvāri stry adhyakṣān susamāhitān
verses.translation: There he saw aged palace-supervisors wearing orange coloured clothes, adorning themselves well, having canes in their hands, well composed and being posted at door-ways.

verses.devanagari:
ते समीक्ष्य समायान्तं रामप्रियचिकीर्षवः |
सहसोत्पतिताः सर्वे ह्यसनेभ्यः ससम्भ्रमाः
verses.iast:
te samīkṣya samāyāntam rāma priya cikīrṣavaḥ |
saha bhāryāya rāmāya kṣipram eva ācacakṣire
verses.translation: All of them, the well-wishers of Rama, saw that Sumantra arriving and raised from their seats hurriedly at once.

verses.devanagari:
तानुवाच विनीतात्मा सूतपुत्रः प्ररक्षिणः |
क्षिप्रमाख्यात रामाय सुमन्त्रे द्वारि तिष्ठति
verses.iast:
prativeditam āGYāya sūtam abhyantaram pituḥ |
tatra eva ānāyayām āsa rāghavaḥ priya kāmyayā
verses.translation: That humble-minded Sumantra spoke to them thus, "Tell Rama immediately that Sumantra is waiting with reverence at the entrance"

verses.devanagari:
ते राममुपसंगम्य भर्तुः प्रियचिकीर्षवः |
सहभार्याय रामाय क्षिप्रमेवाचचक्षिरे
verses.iast:
te rāmamupasamgamya bhartuḥ priyacikīrśhavaḥ |
sahabhāryāya rāmāya kśipramevācacakśire
verses.translation: They, the well-wishers of their master, approached Rama who was with his wife and immediately informed him.

verses.devanagari:
प्रतिवेदितमाज्ञाय सूतमभ्यन्तरं पितुः |
तत्रैवानाययामास राघवः पियकाम्यया
verses.iast:
prativeditamājJṇāya sūtamabhyamtaram pituḥ |
tatraivānāyayāmāsa rāghavaḥ piyakāmyayā
verses.translation: Knowing that Sumantra, who was intimate to his father, came, Rama who desired to show kindness, called him in there.

verses.devanagari:
तं वैश्रवणसंकाशमुपविष्टुं स्वलंकृतम् |
ददर्श सूतः पर्यङ्गे ससैवर्णे सोत्तरच्छदे
वराहरुघिराभेण शुचिना च सुगन्धिना |
अनुलिप्तं पराघर्येन चन्दनेन परंतपम्
स्थितया पार्श्वतश्चापि वालव्यजनहस्तयास्थितया पार्श्वतश्चापि |
उपेतं सीतया भूयः चित्रया शशिनं यथा
verses.iast:
tam vaiśravaṇa samkāśam upaviṣṭam svalamkṛtam |
dādarśa sūtaḥ paryanke sauvaṇo sa uttarac cade
varāha rudhira ābheṇa śucinā ca sugandhinā |
anuliptam para ardhyena candanena param tapam
sthitayā pārśvataḥ ca api vāla vyajana hastayā |
upetam sītayā bhūyaḥ citrayā śaśinam yathā
verses.translation: That Sumantra saw Rama sitting like Kubera on a golden couch with the best cloth-covering. He adorned himself well and had the body anointed with sandal perfume, purely smelling like blood of a boar. With Sita, standing on his side with chowrie in her hand, Rama was shining like moon with chitra star.

glosses.meaning: with the best of cloth = covering

verses.devanagari:
तं तपन्तमिवादित्यम्पपन्नं स्वतेजसा |
ववन्दे वरदम् बन्दी नियमज्ञो विनीतवत्
verses.iast:
tam tapantam iva ādityam upapannam sva tejasā |
vavande varadam bandī niyamaGYo vinītavat
verses.translation: Sumantra, who knew polite conduct, offered salutation to Rama, who was refined with his own brilliance, shining like the sun and the fulfiller of desires.

verses.devanagari:
प्राञ्जलिः ससुमुखं दृष्ट्वा विहारशयनासने |
राजपुत्रमुवाचेदं सुमन्त्रो राजसत्कृतः
verses.iast:
prānjalis tu sukham pṛṣṭvā vihāra śayana āsane |
rāja putram uvāca idam sumantraḥ rāja satkṛtaḥ
verses.translation: Sumantra, who was treated with respect by Rama spoke thus with folded hands to that prince with beautiful face and who was seated on a swinging sofa.

glosses.meaning: who was treated with respect by Rama
and who was seated on a swinging sofa.

verses.devanagari:
कौसल्या सुप्रभा राम पिता त्वं द्रष्टुमिच्छति |
महिष्यापि हि कैकेय्या गम्यताम् तत्र माचिरम्
verses.iast:
kausalyā suprabhā deva pitā tvam draṣṭum iccati |
mahiṣyā saha kaikeyyā gamyatām tatra māciram
verses.translation: "Oh Rama, the good offspring of Kausalya! Your father and the Queen Kaikeyi want to see you. Go there soon."

glosses.meaning: the good offspring of Kausalya! pitaa = your father

verses.devanagari:
एवमुक्तस्तु संहृष्टो नरसिंहो महाद्युतिः |
ततः सम्मानयाम् सीतामिदमुवाच ह
verses.iast:
evam uktaḥ tu samhṛṣṭaḥ nara simho mahā dyutiḥ |
tataḥ sammānayām āsa sītām idam uvāca ha
verses.translation: That best of men with great brilliance was pleased to hear those words, then honoured him and spoke thus to Sita.

verses.devanagari:
देवि देवश्च देवी च समागम्य मदंतरे |
मन्त्रेयेते ध्रुवं किंचित् अभिषेचन संहितम्
verses.iast:
devi devaḥ ca devī ca samāgamya mad antare |
mantreyete dhruvam kiṃcit abhiṣecana samhitam
verses.translation: "Oh Sita! The king and the queen together are thinking of something about me, relating to coronation. It is certain."

verses.devanagari:
लक्षयित्वा ह्यभिप्रायं प्रियकामा सुदक्षिणा |
संचोदयति राजानं मदर्थ मसितेक्षणा
verses.iast:
lakṣayitvā hi abhiprāyam priya kāmā sudakṣiṇā |
saṃcodayati rājānam mad artham madira īkṣaṇā
verses.translation: "Then black-eyed Kaikeyi who is dexterous and friendly disposed, has perceived the king's opinion and is inciting him for my sake"

verses.devanagari:
सा प्रहृष्टा महाराजं हितकामानुवर्तिनी |
जननी चार्थकामा मे केकयाधिपतेस्सुता
verses.iast:
sā prahṛśhṭā mahārājam hitakāmānuvartinī |
jananī cārthakāmā me kekayādhipatessutā
verses.translation: "Kaikeyi, my mother is following the king's intentions with great pleasure, desirous of my benefit and prosperity"

verses.devanagari:
दिष्ट्या खलु महाराजो महिष्या प्रियया सह |
सुमन्त्रं प्रहिणोद् दूतमर्थकामकरं मम
verses.iast:
diśhṭyā khalu mahārājo mahiśhyā priyayā saha |
sumamtram prāhiṇoddūta marthakāmakaram mama
verses.translation: "It is certainly our luck that king and queen have sent Sumantra, who fulfils my desires and wishes, as messenger".

glosses.meaning: who fulfils my desires and wishes

verses.devanagari:
यादृशी परिषत् तत्र तादृशो दूताअगतः |
ध्रुवमधैव मां राजा यौवराज्येऽभिषेक्ष्यति
verses.iast:
yādṛśī pariṣat tatra tādṛśo dūtāagataḥ |
dhruvam adya eva mām rājā yauvarājye abhiṣekṣyati
verses.translation: "A worthy messenger has come who is truly representing the assembly there. It is certain that today itself the king will anoint me for the right of succession to kingdom".

glosses.meaning: of which sort of tatra parishhat that sort of
for the right of succession to kingdom.

verses.devanagari:
हन्त शिघ्रमितो जत्वा द्रक्ष्यामि च महिपतिम् |
सह त्वं परिवारेण सुखमास्स्व रमस्व च
verses.iast:
hanta śīghram itaḥ gatvā drakṣyāmi ca mahī patiḥ |
saha tvam parivāreṇa sukham āssva ramasya ca
verses.translation: "I shall go immediately and see the king. You stay happily with the circle of friends and enjoy yourself."

verses.devanagari:
पतिसम्मानिता सीता भर्तारम्असितक्षणा |
आ द्वारमनुवव्राज मङ्गलान्यभिदध्युषी
verses.iast:
pati sammānitā sītā bhartāram asita īkṣaṇā |
ādvāram anuvavrāja mangalāni abhidadhyuṣī
verses.translation: Sita, treated with respect by her husband and having black eyes, followed her husband up to the door, thinking of auspicious things in her mind.

verses.devanagari:
राज्यं द्विजतिभीर्जुष्टं राजसूयभिषेचनम् |
कर्तुमर्हति ते राजा वासवस्येव लोककृत्
verses.iast:
rājyam dvijātibhirjuśhṭam rājasūyābhiśhecanam |
kartumarhati te rājā vāsavasyeva lokakṛt
verses.translation: "King Dasaratha will give you kingdom, being served by brahmanas, which will invest you with eligibility to perform the great sacrifice at the coronation ceremony like Brahma to Devendra."

glosses.meaning: great sacrifice at coronation of king.

verses.devanagari:
दीक्षितं व्रतसम्पन्नं वराजिनधरं शुचिम् |
कुरङ्गशृङ्गपाणिं च पश्यन्ती त्वां भजाम्यहम्
verses.iast:
dīkśitam vratasampannam varājinadharam śucim |
kuraṇ^gapāṇim ca paśyantī tvām bhajāmyaham
verses.translation: "I shall be delighted to see you, initiated for the perfect religious act of austerity, wearing excellent antelope-hide, being pure and bearing a deer-horn in hand".

glosses.meaning: for perfect religious act of austerity
and bearing a deer-horn in hand.

verses.devanagari:
पुर्वां दिशं वज्रधरो दक्षिणां पातु ते यमः |
वरुणः पाश्चिमामाशां धनेशस्तुत्तरं दिशम्
verses.iast:
pūrvām diśam vajradharo dakśiṇām pātu te yamaḥ |
varuṇaḥ paścimāmāśām dhaneśastūttarām diśam
verses.translation: "May Indra the god of rain in the east, Yama the god of death in the south, Varuna the regent of the ocean in the west and Kubera the god of riches and treasure in the north, protect you".

verses.devanagari:
अथ सीतामनुज्ञाप्य कृतकौतुकमगळः |
निश्चक्राम सुमन्त्रेण सह रामो निवेशनात्
verses.iast:
atha sītāmanujJṇāpya kṛtakautukamagaLaḥ |
niścakrāma sumantreṇa saha rāmo niveśanāt
verses.translation: Rama, adorned as in an auspicious festivity, took permission from Sita and started from house along with Sumantra.

glosses.meaning: adorned as in an auspicious ceremony

verses.devanagari:
पर्वतादिव निष्क्रम्य सिंहो गिरिगुहाशयः |
लक्ष्मणंद्वारि सोऽपश्यत् प्रह्वञ्जलिपुटं स्थितम्
verses.iast:
parvatādiva niśhkramya simho giriguhāśayaḥ |
lakśmaṇam dvāriso'paśyat prahvaJṇjalipuṭam sthitam
verses.translation: That Rama who came out, like a lion residing in a mountain cave from out of the mountain, saw Lakshmana standing at the door, bowing with palms of the hand joined and put to the forehead as a mark of respect.

glosses.meaning: bowing with the palms of hand joined and put to forehead as a mark of respect.

verses.devanagari:
अथ मध्यमकक्ष्यायां समागच्छत् सुहृज्जनैः |
स सर्वानर्थिनो दृष्ट्वा समेत्य प्रतिनन्द्य च
ततः पावकसंकाशमारुरोह रथोत्तमम् |
वैयाघ्रं पुरुष्व्याघो राजितं राजनंदनः
verses.iast:
atha madhyamakakśyāyām samāgacchat suhṛjjanaiḥ |
sa sarvān arthino dṛṣṭvā sametya pratinandya ca
tataḥ pāvaka samkāśam āruroha ratha uttamam |
vaiyāghram puruśhvyā gho rājitam rājanaṃdanaḥ
verses.translation: Then, that prince the best of men, met his friends in the middle chamber. He saw all the people who came there to behold him, approached nearer to them, greeted them and mounted the excellent chariot, which was resplendent like fire and covered with tiger's skin.

glosses.meaning: the friends madhya kakashhyaayaam = in the middle chamber

verses.devanagari:
मेघनादमसम्बाधं मणिहेमविभूशितम् |
मुष्णन्तम् इव चक्षूंषि प्रभया मेरुवर्चसम्
करेणुशिशुकल्पैश्च युक्तं परमवाजिभिः |
हरियुक्तं सहस्राक्षो रथमिन्द्र इवाशुगम्
प्रययौ तूरमास्थाय राघवो ज्वलितः श्रिया |
verses.iast:
meghanādamasambādham maṇihemavibhūśitam |
muṣṇantam iva cakṣūmṣi prabhayā hema varcasam
kareṇu śiśu kalpaiḥ ca yuktam parama vājibhiḥ |
hari yuktam sahasra akṣo ratham indraiva āśugam
prayayau tūrṇam āsthāya rāghavo jvalitaḥ śriyā |
verses.translation: That chariot was sounding like thunder. It was not congested. It was decorated with gold and jewels. Its splendour was like that of Meru mountain, stealing the eyes. Excellent horses looking like infantine elephants were tied to the chariot, which was moving quickly. That Rama shining with splendour like Indra, the lord of sky, mounted such a chariot and went forth quickly.

verses.devanagari:
स पर्जन्य इवाकाशे स्वनवानभिनादयन्
निकेतान्निर्ययौ श्रिमान् महाभ्रादिव चन्द्रमाः |
verses.iast:
sa parjanyaiva ākāśe svanavān abhinādayan
niketān niryayau śrīmān mahā abhrāt iva candramāḥ |
verses.translation: That splendid chariot, sounding like rain-cloud in the sky, came out of the house like moon coming out of a mighty cloud.

verses.devanagari:
चित्रचामरपाणिस्तु लक्ष्मणो राघवानुजः
जुगोप भ्रातरं भ्राता रथमास्थाय पृष्ठतः |
verses.iast:
catra cāmara pāṇis tu lakṣmaṇo rāghava anujaḥ
jugopa bhrātaram bhrātā ratham āsthāya pṛṣṭhataḥ |
verses.translation: Lakshmana, Rama's younger brother mounted the chariot in the back-side and protected Rama with umbrella and chamara fan.

glosses.meaning: having umbrella and chamara fan in hand.

verses.devanagari:
ततो हलहलाशब्दस्तुमुलह् समजायत
तस्य निष्क्रममाणस्य जनौघस्य समन्ततः |
verses.iast:
tataḥ hala halā śabdaḥ tumulaḥ samajāyata
tasya niṣkramamāṇasya jana oghasya samantataḥ |
verses.translation: Then, the crowds started dispersing from all sides generating tumultuous hallowing sound.

verses.devanagari:
ततो हयवरा मुख्या नागाश्च गिरिसन्निभाः
अनुजग्मुस्तदा रामं शतशोऽथ सहस्रशः |
verses.iast:
tato hayavarā mukhyā nāgāśca girisannibhāḥ
anujagmustadā rāmam śataśo'tha sahasraśaḥ |
verses.translation: Thereupon, hundreds and thousands of important people mounted on excellent horses and soldiers mounted on elephants, then followed Rama.

verses.devanagari:
अग्रतश्चास्य सन्नद्धाश्चन्दनागुरुभूषिताः
खड्गचापधराः शूरा जग्मुराशंसवो जनाः |
verses.iast:
agrataścāsya sannaddhāścandanāgurubhūśhitāḥ
khaḍgacāpadharāḥ śūrā jagmurāśaṃsavo janāḥ |
verses.translation: Valiant persons, dressed in armour adorned with sandal and aloe perfumes, wearing swords and bows, declaring the arrival of Rama, went in front of Rama to receive him.

glosses.meaning: adorned with sandal and aloe perfumes

verses.devanagari:
ततो वादित्रशब्दाश्च स्तुतिशब्दाश्च वन्दिनाम्
सिंहनादाश्च शूराणां तदा शुश्रुविरे पथि |
verses.iast:
tato vāditraśabdāśca stutiśabdāśca vandinām
simhanādāśca śūrāṇām tadā śuśruvire pathi |
verses.translation: At that time, sounds of musical instruments, sounds of praising hymns of panagyrists and lion-like roars of valiant persons were heard on the way.

verses.devanagari:
हर्म्यवातायनस्थाभिर्भूषिताभिः समन्ततः
कीर्यमाणः सुपुष्पौघैर्ययौ स्त्रीभिररिंदमः |
verses.iast:
harmyavātāyanasthābhirbhūśhitābhiḥ samantataḥ
kīryamāṇaḥ supuśhpaughairyayau strībhirariṃdamaḥ |
verses.translation: While Rama, the annihilator of enemies, was going, well-adorned women standing in porticoes of palaces, sprinkled flowers on him from all sides.

verses.devanagari:
रामं सर्वानवद्याण्ग्यो रामपिप्रीषया ततः
वचोभिरग्र्यैर्हर्म्यस्थाः क्षितिस्थाश्च ववन्दिरे |
verses.iast:
rāmam sarvānavadyāṇgyo rāmapiprīśhayā tataḥ
vacobhiragryairharmyasthāḥ kśitisthāśca vavandire |
verses.translation: Women of exquisitely beautiful form standing in palaces and on ground were offering salutations to Rama with the best words with a desire to please Rama.

glosses.meaning: and on ground vavandhire = were offering salutations

verses.devanagari:
नूनं नन्दति ते माता कौसल्या मातृनन्दन
पश्यन्ती सिद्धयात्रं त्वं पित्र्यं राज्यमुपस्थितम् |
verses.iast:
nūnam nandhiti te mātā kausalyā mātṛnandana
paśyantī siddhayātram tvām pitryam rājyamupasthitam |
verses.translation: "Oh, Rama, who creates happiness to mother! Have successful journey! Your mother Kausalya will be certainly delighted to see you obtaining the paternal kingdom."

glosses.meaning: the one creates happiness to mother! siddhayaatram = have successful journey

verses.devanagari:
सर्वसीमन्तिनीभ्यश्च सीतां सीमन्तिनीं वराम्
अमन्यन्त हि ता नार्यो रामस्य हृदयप्रियाम् |
verses.iast:
sarvasīmantinībhyaśca sītām sīmantinīm varām
amanyanta hi tā nāryo rāmasya hṛdayapriyām |
verses.translation: Those women thought that Sita, who is dear to Rama's heart, is better woman than all women.

glosses.meaning: who is dear to Rama's heart

verses.devanagari:
तया सुचरितं देव्या पुरा नूनं महत्तपः
रोहिणीव शशाङ्केन रामसंयोगमाप या |
verses.iast:
tayā sucaritam devyā purā nūnam mahattapaḥ
rohiṇīva śaśāṇ^kena rāmasamyogamāpa yā |
verses.translation: "As Rohini star stays together with the moon, Sita having obtained Rama as husband must have certainly performed a great penance in former times."

verses.devanagari:
इति प्रासादशृङ्गेषु प्रमदाभिर्नरोत्तमः
शुश्राव राजमार्गस्थः प्रिया वाच उदाहृताः |
verses.iast:
iti prāsādaśṛṇ^geśhu pramadābhirnarottamaḥ
śuśrāva rājamārgasthaḥ priyā vāca udāhṛtāḥ |
verses.translation: While going through the royal road, Rama heard those pleasant words spoken thus by women standing in turrets.

glosses.meaning: who was in the royal road

verses.devanagari:
स राघवस्त्रत्र तदा प्रलापान् |
शुश्राव लोकस्य समागतस्य |
आत्माधिकारा विविधाश्च वाचः |
प्रहृष्टरूपस्य पुरे जनस्य
verses.iast:
sa rāghavaḥ tatra kathā pralāpam |
śuśrāva lokasya samāgatasya |
ātma adhikārā vividhāḥ ca vācaḥ |
prahṛṣṭa rūpasya pure janasya
verses.translation: Then, Rama heard the words of people gathered there and also the words variously pertaining to himself, by citizens.

verses.devanagari:
एष श्रियं गच्छति राघवोऽद्य|
राजप्रसादातद् विपुलं गमिष्यन् |
एते वयम् सर्वसमृद्धकामा|
योषामयं नो भविता प्रशास्ता
verses.iast:
eṣa śriyam gaccati rāghavo adya |
rāja prasādāt vipulām gamiṣyan |
ete vayam sarva samṛddha kāmā |
yeṣām ayam no bhavitā praśāstā
verses.translation: "By the king's propitiousness, this Rama today is going to obtain this earth and the wealthy kingdom. All our desires are going to be fulfilled because Rama will become the ruler."

verses.devanagari:
लाभो जनस्यास्य यदेष सर्वं|
प्रपत्स्यते राष्ट्रमिदं चिराय |
न ह्यप्रियं किंचन जातु कश्चित् |
पश्येन्न कुःखं मनुजादिपेऽस्मिन्
verses.iast:
lābho janasya asya yad eṣa sarvam |
prapatsyate rāṣṭram idam cirāya |
sa ghoṣavadbhiḥ ca hayaiḥ sanāgaiḥ |
purahsaraiḥ svastika sūta māgadhaiḥ
verses.translation: "If Rama rules this state for a long time, it will be a great benefit to the people. If he becomes a king none can see dislike and sorrow at any time."

verses.devanagari:
स घोषवद्भिश्च हयैः सनागैः |
पुरस्सरैः स्वस्तिकसूतमागधैः |
महीयमानः प्रवरैश्च वादकैः |
अभिष्टुतो वैश्रवणो यथा ययौ
verses.iast:
sa ghośhavadbhiśca hayaiḥ sanāgaiḥ |
purassaraiḥ svastikasūtamāgadhaiḥ |
mahīyamānaḥ pravaraiḥ ca vādakaiḥ |
abhiṣṭutaḥ vaiśravaṇo yathā yayau
verses.translation: While bards and panegyrists were moving in front praising with great respect, invoking blessings and eulogised by the most excellent instrumentalists, Rama, like Kubera the god of wealth, went with resounding horses and elephants.

glosses.meaning: like Kubera the god of weatlh

verses.devanagari:
करेणुमात्ङ्गरथाश्वसंकुलं |
महाजनौघैः परिपूर्णचत्वरम् |
प्रभूतरत्नं बहुपण्यसंचयं |
ददर्श रामो विमलं महापथम्
verses.iast:
kareṇu mātanga ratha aśva samkulam |
mahā jana oghaiḥ paripūrṇa catvaram |
pabhūtaratnam bahupaṇyasaṃcayam |
dadarśa rāmo vimalam mahāpatham
verses.translation: Rama saw the great royal road which was spotlessly clean, having diamonds and various vendible commodities. It was full of male and female elephants, horses and chariots. There was abundance of people gathered at road junctions.

glosses.meaning: full of female and male elephants
